text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you again today!
It's goodbye until tomorrow!!

After parting ways with Taiki Shuttle,
on the way back to my room—
(Pitter, patter...)

It started raining.
...Unfortunately, I don't have an umbrella with me.
I have to hurry home—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaann!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness! I made it in time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I brought an umbrella!
Now you won't get wet, Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: …It looks like you don't have an umbrella, though.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oops! I completely forgot!
I am such a scatterbrain, aren't I!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, well then, let's head home together, SHALL WE!

And so, sharing the umbrella Taiki Shuttle
brought for me, I headed back to my room.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Trainer, you're safe and sound!
What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! You're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, buying that folding umbrella like you suggested back then was definitely the right move, Trainer.
Hearing that, I look at the umbrella leaning by the entrance—
That umbrella was the one I had bought with her at the shopping mall before.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I am so glad
I could be of help to you, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Thanks for coming to pick me up!
I was pretty reluctant when I bought it back then, though.
Looks like I owe you one.
Looks like I owe you one.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I am so glad
I could be of help to you, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Thanks for coming to pick me up!
I was pretty reluctant when I bought it back then, though.
Looks like I owe you one.
Looks like I owe you one.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! Please don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san is always working
hard for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to do all sorts of things
for Trainer-san too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, being able to help Trainer today
makes me so HAPPY! It's the best day ever!
Taiki Shuttle said with a beaming smile.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... I am so sorry about that.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Still, having an umbrella is convenient, isn't it?
I've gained a new appreciation for them today.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Heheh, I look forward to ze next rainy day!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "If you're ever in trouble, Trainer, I'll come pick you right up!"
Taiki Shuttle declared with great energy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! Do I owe you one?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, lucky!
Then please repay that favor the next rainy day!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Next time, you come pick me up, okay?
Are you all right?
Taiki Shuttle smiled mischievously as she said that.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Weeell... you don't need to worry about it at all~.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Because you're always taking care of El!
So between the two of us, no one owes anything, desu!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ah, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: If you are truly that desperate to repay the favor, I suppose I could accept.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, let's see~... Well then~...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go on another fun outing sometime?
Then we'll be even♪
Taiki Shuttle made that request with a happy look on her face.
